en-US.title: A-Claro
en-US.subtitle: See allergy clearly
en-US.description:
A-Claro is an Aclearo allergy companion app. Offline-first diary, explainable product scanner, pollen and air context, SOS passport, and doctor-ready PDF reports — in 6 languages.

A-Claro helps you see allergy information clearly: scan barcodes, log symptoms, track environmental triggers, and share structured reports with your clinician. Not a medical device — decision support only.
